h1.en: Keep Diesel 30 Concrete Pump under “ISO B Series” without new ratings
h1.zh: 在「ISO B 串联」下保留柴油30型混凝土泵，不另写额定值

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Diesel 30 Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/diesel-30-concrete-pump. [ 1 ]. Hopper Capacity 0.3 m³. Outlet Pressure 20 MPa. Main Unit Weight 2000 kg. Theoretical Output 15 m³/h. Aggregate Size 3 cm and below. The printed output cell is 15 m³/h. Diesel Engine (Power) 4105 / 56 kW. The printed power cell is 4105 / 56 kW. The published cells are: Model Diesel 30. Dimensions (L×W×H) 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm. Copy only the printed cells: Model Diesel 30. Put /products/diesel-30-concrete-pump in the subject. The printed aggregate or particle cell is 3 cm and below. The printed distance row or rows: Pumping Distance (H / V) 60 m / 180 m. For transport, copy Dimensions (L×W×H) is 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm and Main Unit Weight is 2000 kg. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the Diesel 30 Concrete Pump at /products/diesel-30-concrete-pump. Theoretical Output is 15 m³/h OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/diesel-30-concrete-pump. The section title “ISO A Series” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是柴油30型混凝土泵的数字。要打开的行是 /products/diesel-30-concrete-pump。料斗容积 0.3 m³.整机重量 2000 kg。最大出口压力 20 MPa.理论输送量 15 m³/h.已印输送量是 15 m³/h。柴油机功率 4105 / 56 kW.已印动力是 4105 / 56 kW。只抄已印格子：型号 Diesel 30.已公布的格子是：型号 Diesel 30.最大骨料粒径 3 cm and below.已印骨料或粒径是 3 cm and below。外形尺寸 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm.已印距离行：输送距离（水平/垂直） 60 m / 180 m。主题里写上 /products/diesel-30-concrete-pump。运输请抄外形尺寸是 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm，整机重量是 2000 kg。河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油30型混凝土泵列在 /products/diesel-30-concrete-pump。理论输送量是 15 m³/h OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/diesel-30-concrete-pump 开始。节标题「ISO 串联」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

question.zh: 「ISO 串联」会替换「料斗容积 0.3 m³」吗？

answer.en: No. [ 1 ] remains the printed wording for Diesel 30 Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。料斗容积 0.3 m³仍是柴油30型混凝土泵已印的说法。

question.en: Where does Hopper Capacity 0.3 m³ belong on the Diesel 30 Concrete Pump row?
question.zh: 柴油30型混凝土泵这一行里，「整机重量 2000 kg。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/diesel-30-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/diesel-30-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “ISO B Series” add to Diesel 30 Concrete Pump?
question.zh: 「ISO B 串联」给柴油30型混凝土泵增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/drawings-paper-sheets-sizes-d_349.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/drawings-paper-sheets-sizes-d_349.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。
